messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about HISTORY in German Reich (1871-1945) during the 1920s and 1930s, matching this research need: Voting-district-level election results for Kiel covering Reichstag elections in 1928, 1930, July and November 1932, plus Reich presidential elections in 1925 and 1932.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Kiel Stimmbezirk Wahlergebnisse Reichstagswahl 1928 1930 1932 Reichspräsidentenwahl 1925 1932 Datensatz
Kiel historische Wahlergebnisse Stimmbezirke 1925 1928 1930 1932 digital dataset
Weimar elections Kiel precinct level electoral data 1928 1930 1932 1925
action.query: Kiel Stimmbezirk Wahlergebnisse Reichstagswahl 1928 1930 1932 Reichspräsidentenwahl 1925 1932 Datensatz

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Die Reichstagswahlen und Reichspräsidentschaftswahlen in Kiel 1925–1932 (The Reichstag Elections and Reich Presidential Elections in Kiel, 1925–1932) — GESIS ZA8080","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.8080","justification":"Exact match for the research need. This dataset, compiled by Wolfram Schulz and archived by GESIS, contains voting-district-level election results for 156 Stimmbezirke (voting districts) in Kiel, German Reich. It covers all six requested elections: Reichstag elections in May 1928, September 1930, July 1932, and November 1932, plus Reich presidential elections in 1925 and 1932. The dataset contains 50 variables and is available in SPSS and Stata formats. Results were collected from contemporary newspapers, including the Schleswig-Holsteinische Volkszeitung and Kieler Neueste Nachrichten. Important limitation: The records provide vote counts but do not include voter turnout or results for minor fringe parties. Published in 2008, with dataset version 1.0.0 dated April 13, 2010. This is the strongest available match because its geographic coverage, electoral periods, and voting-district granularity correspond exactly to the query."},{"title":"Wahlstatistische Datenbank für Schleswig-Holstein 1919–1938 — Arbeitskreis zur Erforschung des Nationalsozialismus in Schleswig-Holstein (AKENS)","url_or_doi":"https://www.akens.org/materialien-zur-zeitgeschichte/historische-statistik.html","justification":"Highly relevant complementary historical election database covering Schleswig-Holstein between 1919 and 1938, including Kiel. Its holdings include election results at the municipality, district, and individual polling-station levels. The database explicitly includes Stimmbezirk-level results for Kiel and covers Reichstag and presidential elections during the Weimar Republic. It can supplement the GESIS dataset with additional historical election records and geographic context. Coverage and availability of individual Kiel polling-station records should be checked for each requested election."},{"title":"German Weimar Republic Data, 1919–1933 — ICPSR Study 42","url_or_doi":"https://www.icpsr.umich.edu/web/ICPSR/studies/42","justification":"Relevant supplementary dataset containing German electoral and demographic information from the Weimar Republic. It includes Reichstag election returns for 1920–1933 and Reich presidential election results for 1925 and 1932, including runoff elections. The dataset records party and candidate vote totals, eligible voters, and electoral participation, making it useful for contextualizing Kiel's electoral patterns within national and regional trends. However, its geographic units are Kreis, Land/Regierungsbezirk, and Wahlkreis rather than individual Kiel voting districts. It therefore does not independently satisfy the requested Stimmbezirk-level granularity."},{"title":"Wahlstatistische Datenbank, Schleswig-Holstein 1919–1938 — AKENS Historical Election Data Archive","url_or_doi":"https://www.akens.org/akens/texte/diverses/wahldaten/index.html","justification":"An additional entry point to AKENS historical electoral statistics covering Schleswig-Holstein during the Weimar Republic and National Socialist period. The archive documents election results from 1919 through 1938, including Reichstag elections, presidential elections, and other votes. Its records include results from individual polling districts in selected cities, including Kiel. It is particularly useful for locating historical election tables and complementary records for the July and November 1932 elections. This is an alternative access point to the AKENS collection listed above, not necessarily an independent dataset."}]}
